items.title: Big Tech's equally big debt pile is raising concerns about the AI boom
items.summary: The total capital raised by AI hyperscaler, data center, and neo-cloud companies from high-grade debt sales has doubled from $172 billion in 2025 to $346 billion in 2026 year-to-date, according to Barclays strategist Venu Krishna. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi reacts to Krishna's findings and what it means for the AI ecosystem, especially as major companies prepare to go public.

items.title: OpenAI's Dots connect to 4,000 apps and never sleep
items.summary: OpenAI just unveiled Dots: an always-on AI assistant with 4,000+ tools that might just be the closest thing yet to Tony Stark's "Jarvis." In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen explains how Dots stacks up against Meta's Muse and Elon Musk's Grok Bot, and how OpenAI's other Dev Day launches fit together with the new, 24/7 agent. If you want to know where AI assistants are headed, start here.

items.title: Meta counted Mark Zuckerberg’s $4.1B stock payout as research pay to claim a $355M tax break — and the IRS wants it back
items.summary: Meta says Zuckerberg was writing code when he got his options in 2005. The IRS says only his work from 2008 to 2010 counts, and $355 million rides on who's right.

items.title: Meta reportedly calls its AI data centers ‘pilot models’ — its research tax credits jumped from $700M to $3.9B
items.summary: The company appears to have netted the most from that credit among all publicly traded companies.

items.title: Tech CEOs questioned Anthropic leader over AI safety warnings, WSJ reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Top artificial intelligence executives confronted Anthropic (NASDAQ:ANTP) Chief Executive Dario Amodei during a high-stakes White House gathering, exposing deep strategic fractures across Silicon Valley even as leaders publicly aligned around new safety protocols. The private clash followed a lunch hosted by President Donald Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson, according to reporting from The Wall Street Journal.
